purpose: Reconciles an x402 V2 batch settlement (off-chain payment vouchers vs onchain batch total), verifying recon verdict, per-voucher amounts, settlement-risk window (unredeemed voucher exposure), and computing an educational Merkle root over the voucher set. Runtime/post-trade: art-03 models V1 pre-trade; ART-61 reconciles an actual V2 batch post-settlement.
